description: Cross-platform conformance vectors for the shared catalog decoders. Source of truth: shared-core-rs/crates/hw-catalog/src/cloud_stt.rs and models.rs, read through shared-core-rs/crates/hw-core/src/ffi_catalog.rs. Three stacks run these vectors through their own UniFFI binding: Rust (shared-core-rs/crates/hw-core/tests/catalog_vectors.rs), Swift (app/macos/hyperwhisperTests/CatalogConformanceVectorTests.swift) and C# (app/shared-dotnet/HyperWhisper.CatalogConformance.Tests/Program.cs). Regenerate with: cargo test -p hw-core --test catalog_vectors -- --ignored regenerate. `languagesRawCodeCount` pins the size of the raw upstream code list rather than its contents; `pickerLanguageCodes` pins the fold applied to it. A null `codes` means the catalog declares the set "unverified", so a picker keeps its full list.

cloudSttEntries.languagesCodeFormat: BCP-47 (mix of ISO-639-1 base codes + regional variants)
ISO-639-1 (with `yue`, `haw` ISO-639-3, and Whisper-specific `jw` for Javanese)
